content.text: The existing event bus makes assignment announcements and notifications depend on the stored assignee ID, so redirecting before persistence will cover those consumers naturally. I’m adding a tenant-scoped absence table and wiring the same moment-based lookup into issue creation, reassignment, overdue alerts, and mention fan-out.
